system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that idempotently configures the firewall on a Linux host: allows SSH (port 22), HTTPS (port 443), and explicitly denies all other inbound traffic.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that idempotently configures the firewall on a Linux host: allows SSH (port 22), HTTPS (port 443), and explicitly denies all other inbound traffic.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
- name: Configure firewall to allow only SSH and HTTPS
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  tasks:
    - name: Install and configure firewalld on RedHat/SUSE families
      block:
        - name: Ensure firewalld is installed
          ansible.builtin.package:
            name: firewalld
            state: present

        - name: Ensure firewalld is enabled and running
          ansible.builtin.service:
            name: firewalld
            state: started
            enabled: true

        - name: Set default zone to public
          ansible.posix.firewalld:
            default_zone: public
            permanent: true
            immediate: true

        - name: Allow SSH service (22/tcp) in public zone
          ansible.posix.firewalld:
            service: ssh
            zone: public
            state: enabled
            permanent: true
            immediate: true

        - name: Allow HTTPS service (443/tcp) in public zone
          ansible.posix.firewalld:
            service: https
            zone: public
            state: enabled
            permanent: true
            immediate: true

        - name: Ensure dhcpv6-client is disabled in public zone
          ansible.posix.firewalld:
            service: dhcpv6-client
            zone: public
            state: disabled
            permanent: true
            immediate: true
      when: ansible_facts.os_family in ['RedHat', 'Suse']

    - name: Install and configure UFW on Debian family
      block:
        - name: Ensure UFW is installed
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            name: ufw
            state: present
            update_cache: true

        - name: Set default incoming policy to deny
          community.general.ufw:
            direction: incoming
            policy: deny

        - name: Set default outgoing policy to allow
          community.general.ufw:
            direction: outgoing
            policy: allow

        - name: Allow SSH (22/tcp)
          community.general.ufw:
            rule: allow
            port: "22"
            proto: tcp

        - name: Allow HTTPS (443/tcp)
          community.general.ufw:
            rule: allow
            port: "443"
            proto: tcp

        - name: Enable UFW with IPv6 support
          community.general.ufw:
            state: enabled
            ipv6: true
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == 'Debian'
